items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Amos and Pat Kaune who own Gulliver's, are sponsoring a benefit for The House That Jazz Built on Wednesday, July 23rd.

ctx.x: Your host on the show. You want to say why you were appearing on that show?

Yeah. I went out to do an interview with Art Vincent, because during the time that I was in the hospital, Art had announced it on the radio. And I got a lot of letters of condolence from his having announced this. And so in the meantime, he called me when I got home and wanted to know if I'd come out. Well I had done an interview with Art some years ago. And he remembered that. I supposed he was a little reluctant to ask me to come all the way out to Newark to do an interview, but I was glad to get out there. And…
